desc: Another manufacturer-specific detail pertains to the KIT/Yokogawa/Ricoh system, which saves the MEG sensor coil positions in a separate file with two possible filename extensions (`.sqd`, `.mrk`). For these files, the `markers` suffix MUST be used. For example: `sub-01_task-nback_markers.sqd` Exactly one of: .sqd; .mrk must be present.
